title: wave_front state snapshot
description: A dated estimate of the current state with provenance (DESIGN.md section 5.1, framework_spec.md section 9). Every variable carries a level, a confidence and the indicators it was read from; only a variable with confidence 'assumed' may have an empty indicator list. Rates are validated here and are not part of the state.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

date.description: The date the estimate is for, YYYY-MM-DD.

model.description: The model (or model version) the variable names and levels refer to.

variables.description: Declared model variables by name. A variable declared with init=None in the model must be fixed here.

rates.description: Observed lags and growth caps, by name. Evidence for the rates of the model; they never edit its transition relation.

level.description: A level name for a leveled variable, an integer for a counter, a boolean for a flag.

source.description: Where it was read: a URL or a citation.

observed.description: The date of the observation, YYYY-MM-DD.

rule.description: The mapping rule from the observation to the level.
